cues.text: Sam found forty acres she might buy.
No survey. No soil report. Just an address and an asking price.
Before she makes an offer, she needs one number: what the site work will cost.
Marine clay. Shallow rock. A high water table.
Guess high, she loses the deal. Guess low, and bad dirt can cost hundreds of thousands, or over a million.
DirtBid pulls the official U S D A soil survey and local cost data, then prices the site work line by line. On the safe side, so your offer is too.
Three weeks of due diligence, in under thirty minutes.
Then it hands you a vetted team for every step: survey, civil, geo-tech, title, financing, and the crew that moves the dirt.
Screen your first parcel free, at dirt bid A I dot com.
No credit card. Just the number, before you make the offer.
